invariantRules: Balance and every due position are obligation-scoped, knowledge-timed assertions mastered by WM-POL-011 and never owned by a tax registration account.
A jurisdictional basis never entails registration, and an address alone entails neither registration nor obligation.
Each residence, source, place-of-supply or nexus basis remains independently identified, evidenced and resolvable with or without an account.
Residence, source, place-of-supply and nexus remain distinct and obey the closed basis-to-subject-kind table.
Concurrent jurisdictional bases coexist without implicit ranking, suppression or netting.
Every time-varying assertion is read with mandatory effective and knowledge instants; authority timestamps remain separately recorded.
Account state is revision-owned; currentState is derived and cannot be mutated in place.
Version lineage is backward supersedesRef only, acyclic, single-parent and never identified by content digest.
Authority identifiers are interval-qualified by authority, jurisdiction and tax type; local identities are never recycled.
A balance is neither a second master of an assessment or payment nor erasable into either.
A procedure case and an authority response correlate facts but never own obligations, assessments, notices, acknowledgements or economic amounts.
Every calculation has exactly one owner: ReturnRevision or Obligation; an authority-assessed calculation remains Obligation-owned and requires assessmentRef.
Equal amounts or digests never merge calculations, returns, assessments, obligations or accounts.
Registration never implies an obligation and a basis never implies registration.
All candidate objects are restricted by default; reads are purpose-bound, actor-bound and knowledge-time logged.
A taxable event, obligation and payment may coexist with zero tax registration accounts and zero return revisions.
An account is instantiated only from an authority handle or an explicit opening/application event naming the authority.
Every rule, rate, formula, form, schema, taxonomy and code-set dependency is an opaque effective-and-knowledge-time version pin; local rate copies are forbidden.
Deregistration archives by tombstone and never erases prior obligations, returns, assessments, responses or lineage.
Retention is at least the maximum of an externally pinned statutory minimum and any active legal hold.
Return class is declared explicitly and never inferred from account, taxpayer, period or payload similarity.
TaxProfile is a non-storing view with no masters; obligation scope uses taxTypeRef and obligationClass instead.
